text: Hello boys and girls, welcome to my English class.我是上海师范大学附属宝山经纬实验中学的谢意老师Today we will continue learning unit 5 films.In the previous lessons, we got to know and enjoyed some films.I'm sure you have your own opinions on certain films.Why not share your opinions with us in this period?Are you ready for the class?Before we start, please get your student's book, your worksheet and your pen ready.First, please take a look at some posters and share your opinions.Have you watched the Harry Potter films?What do you think of them?I've seen all the Harry Potter movie series.I think these movies are very exciting and have opened the door to a new world.To me, it is a world full of magic.You can see three main characters in the posters.They are very brave.What's more, I am very excited.Because this series of films will return to the screen.Wow, you really are a fan of Harry Potter films.For you, it is a world full of magic.Magic means 魔法 in Chinese.Read after me.Magic.The IFF has started a forum about teenagers' views on popular films.You are going to leave a short review.Little Joe also saw the forum as well.He has already posted his film review.Let's take a look.This is Little Joe's review.Read his review and answer two questions.Does Little Joe like the film?Yes, he does.How do you know that?Because Little Joe thinks everyone should watch it.He also thinks it is a wonderful film and strongly recommends it.Can you guess the meaning of the word recommend?I think it means he would like other people to watch it.In Chinese, 推薦.Wonderful.Now read after me.Recommend.We know that Little Joe likes the film.What other things does he mention in the film review?Read his review again and complete D2 in Student's Book, page 88.Little Joe mentions the name of the film, setting and plot, characters and special effects.Harry Potter and Philosopher's Stone is the name of the film.The second sentence mentions the setting and plot as well as the character Harry.The third and fourth sentences are about the special effects.Good job.In the second sentence, Harry finds a whole new world of magic, means he finds a completely new world.All of the world is new to him.The word 全 is an adjective.It means 完全的.Among all the things Little Joe mentions, can you tell what he likes and dislikes?He likes the plot and special effects, because he says, I love watching, and he thinks all the magic looks real.However, he thinks there are too many characters for him to remember.He shares his opinions in different aspects.We now have a clear picture about Little Joe's opinion on the film Harry Potter and Philosopher's Stone.Can you tell which sentence is about Little Joe's opinion and which sentences are about what he likes and dislikes?The fifth sentence is Little Joe's opinion.The next three sentences are about what he likes about the film.The fifth sentence is his dislike.The last sentence also shows Little Joe's opinion.Correct.In your opinion, what is the basic structure of a film review?When I write a film review, it should have a topic sentence to give my opinion.Then I should write some details to show my opinion.At last, I should write a sentence to end it.Terrific.The basic structure of a film review begins with a topic sentence.You need to give some supporting statements to further explain the topic sentence.The last sentence to end a paragraph is called a concluding sentence.In Little Joe's review, the concluding sentence is, however, it is still a wonderful film and I strongly recommend you to use it.The word, however, means 无论如何,不管怎样。The meaning of this sentence is the same as the first sentence in the film review.Do you know how to write a concluding sentence?I will write a concluding sentence at the end of my film review.I write this sentence to show my opinion again.As we can see, a concluding sentence always follows the supporting statements and ends a paragraph.It also restates the main idea of a paragraph and gives a final point for readers to take away.We can begin the concluding sentences with some transitional words or phrases.We call these transitional words or phrases concluding sentence starters.Do you know any of them?I know finally and therefore.That's right.Here are some common concluding sentence starters.In brief, in short, in conclusion, in a word, all in all, therefore, finally.In today's review, Little Joe expresses both his likes and dislikes.To restate that he likes the film and to give readers a final point to take away, he used however as a starter.Now you can put what you have learned into practice.Write a concluding sentence for the following review.You can write it down in your worksheet.It is task one.Can you share your answers?All in all, I think it is a wonderful movie and everyone should watch it.In brief, I recommend this movie to all my friends and relatives.Both of you did a good job.Your concluding sentences are proper for the review because in this film review, Little Joe mentions the things he likes about the film Charlotte's Web.Before you write your own film review, it is very important to plan what you are going to write about.You can use the table of these three on page 89 in your student's book.Please complete the table.Thank you for watching.Don't forget to use the table you have just completed to help you finish your work.It is task two in your worksheet.
